stage: Finite independent read-only review of an in-progress AUDITED worktree, before runtime qualification. No build/test/GPU/P1 run. Statements bind only the hashes below; subsequent edits require their own relevant review.

findings.counterexample: Root passes the loop-top cancel check, polls an existing pending episode, cancellation is set and request_cancel returns during that observation, then root enters its second claim critical section. The earlier draft checked only pipeline_error there, so it could claim and submit a previously unclaimed native math/transfer job after cancellation. CPU claim and serial drive_stage already checked cancellation.
findings.minimal_fix_by_root: Recheck cancel under the second pipeline_mutex acquisition, Update(Cancelled), then reject take when pipeline_error is non-OK. Current Apple466-469 and Vulkan528-531 have this check. Already-claimed/accepted work is still retained/drained; no GPU preemption promise.
findings.finite_verification: Existing completion-observation decoration may pause pending observation after the loop-top check; cancel and release it, then verify that later ready native/transfer admission count does not increase. Not run by reviewer.

invariants.finding: Only input stages with fragment==SIZE_MAX are marked initially_complete. Host binding skips download, native input skips repack/upload together; exact page bindings defer actual source permissions to the original page controller. Produced fragment outputs never become ready from this mask. Each math consumer also depends on its host/native representation stage plus original fragment data/control constraints; upload/download is not silently replaced by a placeholder native owner.

CPU math checks completion, copies/commits host_value before locked frontier.complete. Apple native math only publishes output arrays after successful owning submitted.wait; Vulkan checks the original frozen output buffers after owning wait. Vulkan download polls/waits successful transfer, reads staging to the destination, sets host_value, then marks ready under pipeline_mutex. Producer writes happen-before consumer take on the same monitor; consumers cannot use the cold native/boundary placeholder as a data-ready signal.

invariants.area: Native pending work and multiple eligible jobs
invariants.finding: Each fragment retains its original OwnedResult in FragmentRun.pending; Vulkan retains actual transfer Completion in ValueRun.pending_transfer. New admission protects once before first poll. False/pending retains the handle and fixed pending-job identity; the root services other ready work rather than unconditionally waiting one math episode. Completed work publishes first, drops the completed handle and is removed from pending. Pending storage is cold-sized by stage count, with no per-job fiber. Apple copies retain their original synchronous MemoryResource boundary; this review does not claim every native call is nonblocking.

lease_mutex serializes next_prefix/retention attachment for simultaneous CPU/native protection. No provider math, poll, native wait, staging read or copy is inside that lock. LeaseSubmission has a body sentinel, so immediate prefix callbacks cannot terminal-publish while a lane is still admitting work. The declared maximum 2*inputs + fragments + sum(fragment.outputs) covers input repack+upload versus input download, one math prefix per fragment and one crossing copy per output; native pending re-polls do not attach another prefix.

invariants.area: First error / cancel and true retirement
invariants.finding: First error is monitor-protected; cancellation stops unclaimed work including the corrected native claim point. Root waits cpu_stopped before dropping any native pending holders. It then clears all Run-owned pending math/transfer handles before LeaseSubmission.finish releases the body sentinel. Native abandonment hands already-accepted work to its original completion/reaper; every attached prefix separately retains the Run and only releases on real retirement. Removing pending holders breaks the Run -> native handle -> retained Run cycle. The body sentinel prevents premature final publication while clearing multiple holders; remaining callbacks preserve resources and failed slot exclusion until all accepted work retires. An observed error is not itself retirement.

invariants.area: CPU Queue and mutable slot ownership
invariants.anchors: Apple drive_lane/drive_cpu_lane:405-431,489-497; Vulkan:469-493,551-559; create_invocation and admit/ResultSlot paths
invariants.finding: Parallel mode has a sole CPU child for CPU fragments and repack jobs; native stages cannot submit CPU Queue work. Root owns native/copy submission. Each lane takes/completes frontier under the same short monitor, with execution/waits outside. Child retains RunState until after its stopped notification; no further resettable state access follows. Separate slots keep independent frontier, mutable native/CPU invocations, boundary/staging and old-result exclusion. Original caller Queue ownership constraints remain.

One ValueRun has at most the needed upload or download for its original representation/producer, and its pending handle remains valid until successful wait/read. The original TransferSlot refuses reuse with pending/completion_owner/observers/retiring state and records source/staging native owners; read requires successful completed download and exact description. No new transfer executor, queue or shader was introduced.

pending_qualification: No runtime/retirement/overlap/sanitizer/delivery/P1 PASS is signed. The current G09 card must still execute both insertion orders, real CPU/native intervals, two slots/65 changes, old results, serial/control/effect/alias holdouts, OOM/admission failure, cancellation and early native/transfer error with outstanding sibling work and no leaked resources. The cancel source fix itself is not a completed runtime test.
limits: No product/benchmark/registry/public-tool edits by reviewer; only this ignored JSON written. No scope or native math/transfer/allocator-owner expansion, new executor/pool, full-library rescan, G01-G08 reopening or inference-engine performance claim.
